evidence_quotes.name_asked: What is the first and last name? ... First name is S-Y-Z-A. Pisa and last name is K-H-A-N.
evidence_quotes.name_never_used_again: Customer name collected but never used after collection throughout remainder of call.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo_absent: No time-boxed framing of the call, no promise of a dependable quote, no wait for customer confirmation before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question_absent: Rep never asks about shipper's top two concerns (on-time reliability, damage to items).
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathering: Rep asks about square footage (2500, 3600), move date (Oct 21), story count (1-story, 2-story), and ending address but does not ask about special items, walking distances, number of rooms, or additional areas.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count_absent: Rep never asks if customer wants packing service or estimates box count.

top_strength: Chauntelle efficiently gathered basic logistics (square footage, story count, addresses, move date) and confirmed availability without wasting time.
coaching_note: This call routes to walkthrough scheduler correctly given the 2500–3600 sqft size, but the rep never delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage), never asked about customer concerns, and never used the customer's name after collection — all three are required even on walkthrough calls because they establish trust before the handoff.
